body:
## Summary

On macOS 26 (darwin 25.6.0, arm64), uv-managed Python interpreters (python-build-standalone, ad-hoc/linker-signed) **hang at interpreter startup when spawned by launchd** (LaunchAgent, directly or via `/bin/sh -c` / `uv run`), while the same binaries start normally from a terminal. `syspolicyd` shows a tight error loop during the hang: `Unable to initialize qtn_proc: 3` + `dispatch_mig_server returned 268435459`, dozens of entries per millisecond, stopping the moment the hung process is killed. Terminal-spawned runs of the identical binary produce **zero** syspolicyd activity.

This looks related to but distinct from #16726 (which reports SIGKILL under launchd): here the process is not killed — it either hangs in interpreter init (`Py_InitializeFromConfig → _PyConfig_InitPathConfig → getpath_readlines`, sleeping, no open FDs) or, with a freshly installed 3.12 build, launchd reports the spawn stuck in `spawn scheduled` with last exit `78: EX_CONFIG`.

## Environment

- uv 0.12.13 (Homebrew)
- uv-managed CPython 3.13.14 and 3.12.14 (`cpython-*-macos-aarch64-none`), both `CodeDirectory flags=0x20002(adhoc,linker-signed)`, `Identifier=-`
- macOS 26 (darwin 25.6.0), arm64
- Prefect 3.6.29 worker context discovered this; reproduced with a bare `python -c 'print(1)'` LaunchAgent

## Reproduction

LaunchAgent plist:

```xml
<key>ProgramArguments</key>
<array>
  <string>/Users/me/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.13.14-macos-aarch64-none/bin/python3.13</string>
  <string>-c</string>
  <string>print('x')</string>
</array>
<key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
<key>StandardOutPath</key><string>/tmp/probe.log</string>
<key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>/tmp/probe.err</string>
```

`launchctl bootstrap gui/$UID ~/Library/LaunchAgents/probe.plist`

Result matrix (same binary everywhere unless noted):

| Spawn | Result |
|---|---|
| launchd → python | hang, no output; `sample` shows 100% of time in `getpath_readlines` (sleeping, no open FDs) |
| launchd → `/bin/sh -c` → python | same hang |
| launchd → `uv run` → python | same hang |
| launchd → `/usr/bin/python3` (Apple-signed) | works |
| terminal → python (`env -i`, stdin=/dev/null) | works |
| terminal-lineage `nohup` daemon running for days | works |

While hung: `/usr/bin/log show --last 1m --predicate 'processImagePath CONTAINS "syspolicyd"'` shows the `qtn_proc` error storm; killing the process stops the storm immediately.

## Mitigations attempted (all ineffective)

- `codesign --force --sign -` on the interpreter + all `.so`/`.dylib` (the workaround from #16726)
- `xattr -dr com.apple.provenance` (the attribute cannot be removed on macOS 26 — silently persists)
- plist `ProcessType=Interactive`
- explicit `PYTHONHOME`

Note: re-signing the interpreter also breaks macOS keychain ACL trust in the original linker-signed cdhash (a separate headache); we restored the pristine install with `uv python install --reinstall`.

## Workaround

Keep daemons out of launchd lineage: spawn from a login-session process (e.g. `nohup` from a terminal/agent session) and supervise externally.

Happy to run any further diagnostics you need (the machine is readily reproducible).
title: macOS 26: launchd-spawned uv-managed Python hangs at interpreter startup with syspolicyd 'Unable to initialize qtn_proc: 3' loop (distinct from #16726 SIGKILL)
